$doc: One record per fine art moment, the still painting in section 2 of every Template A study. Typed by app/data/works.ts, rendered by components/friction-moment.tsx, checked in the build by scripts/lint-works.mjs, and encoded from the masters by scripts/build-fine-art.mjs. The credit line is generated from these fields and never stored, so the credit and the record cannot disagree. display is the 1x box at 1440: the work fits 640 x 640 (--art-max-height) at its natural aspect. files lists the 1x then the 2x delivery file of each format.

works.title: The Millinery Shop
works.alt: A milliner in a green dress holds a hat up to inspect it, with finished hats on stands around her.

caption.gloss: Maria knew the Coast Guard could send a case back, and the form never said what was missing.

works.title: Woman Holding a Balance
works.alt: A woman in a blue jacket stands at a table by a window, holding a small empty balance by its thread and waiting for it to settle.

caption.gloss: Michelle knew one report was wrong, but not which.

works.title: The Fog Warning
works.licence: Public domain image, MFA Terms of Use
works.alt: A fisherman rows a small boat loaded with fish through heavy swell, looking over his shoulder at a fog bank rising on the horizon, a schooner far off.

caption.gloss: Wilbur knew the threats might have moved, and the tool could not tell him where.

works.title: Man Handing a Letter to a Woman in the Entrance Hall of a House
works.alt: In the sunlit entrance hall of a canal house, a seated young woman looks up as a messenger, hat in hand, holds out a letter. The front door stands open to the canal.

caption.gloss: Angela knew she had paid, but not when her order would come.

works.title: The Laundress
works.alt: A laundress climbs stone steps up from the river with a heavy bundle of washing on her hip, reaching back with her free hand to help a small child up behind her.

caption.gloss: Ella knew someone was waiting on every garment, and she never had a free hand.
